title: Stories get star ratings
description: Add starRating, starRatedAt and starRatedBy on Item, and a setItemStars mutation for editor groups, using the same rules as setReferenceStars: separate from stage changes, newest wins, tapping the same star clears it. Item is versioned, so every new version must carry the rating (write this test first; Reference lost its stars this way in 5.78). Reuse components/star-rating.tsx on the Stories board card, story drawer and editor. Rating works at every stage, including the Idea stage and after publication. Never exported to published pages; add to the home-page and projection exclusion guards. Schema change, so it needs the site backend deployed.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Complete: Item fields in both schema files, setItemStars for editors and admins, UI on the board card, drawer and editor, carry_item_stars in each version path, tests and story-stars.feature. Public ranking is PPY-5966d7.
